restaurants.notes: Sources used that the researcher did not: danville-harvest.res-discover.com read directly for the full Google Business attribute set and day-by-day hours (they cited the URL but never pulled the services/highlights payload), visittrivalley.com, lovetrivalley.com, and a fresh pdftotext extraction of all four June 2026 menu PDFs plus a fresh read of /contact and /events. The menu and happy-hour transcription in the journal is accurate — I found no invented dish, no wrong price, and no item copied from a sibling restaurant. The defects are all on the listing side: the claim that the official site publishes no open/close times is simply false; the day-by-day hours are presented as settled when four sources disagree by up to 90 minutes on exactly the nights this directory cares about; the owner attribution has no first-party support; and three dessert prices are DoorDash markups presented as menu facts. Yelp, OpenTable, Tripadvisor, Uber Eats, order.online, wheree and BringFido all returned 403/CAPTCHA to every method, so the rating figures in the journal remain snippet-sourced and should carry that caveat on the live site.
